_readme: One entry per slate on the site and `<!-- shot:id -->` marker in the wiki. To fill one, set `file` to a path under site/assets/img/ (or a YouTube video id for video-*), optionally `poster` and `caption`. The slate turns into the real image on the next deploy. Full briefs: site/PLACEHOLDERS.md.
